label: Episode 31
logline: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 30 where Rupert and Catherine plotted to frame Juliana as a witch while Juliana huddled chained in the subterranean dungeon.

picks.transcript:
CLIP: episode 31, 1 segment(s), 44s
[01:17.80-01:20.20] CATHERINE (Incredulous, Mocking): "You call that marriage?"
[01:20.50-01:23.20] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.
[01:20.80-01:23.20] JULIANA (Pure, Sincere): "I call it love."
[01:23.20-01:28.00] CAMERA: High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.
[01:23.50-01:27.40] CATHERINE (Mocking, Hysterical Laugh): "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."
[01:27.50-01:31.20] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.
[01:27.80-01:31.20] JULIANA (Firm, Piercing): "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."
[01:31.20-01:34.20] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.
[01:31.40-01:34.20] CATHERINE (Incredulous, Offended): "You think love makes you better than me?"
[01:34.20-01:38.20] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.
[01:34.50-01:38.20] JULIANA (Calm, Cutting): "No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."
[01:38.20-01:43.50] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.
[01:38.50-01:43.30] CATHERINE (Incensed, Boastful): "I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"
[01:43.50-01:48.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.
[01:43.70-01:48.50] JULIANA (Quiet, Powerful): "Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."
[01:48.80-01:50.50] CAMERA: Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.
[01:50.20-01:51.40] CATHERINE (Sneering, Derisive): "[scoffs] Peasants? People?"
[01:51.50-01:58.20] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.
[01:51.60-01:58.20] CATHERINE (Arrogant, Elitist): "That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."
[01:58.20-02:02.25] CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.
[01:58.40-02:02.00] JULIANA (Piercing, Provocative): "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"
[02:02.00-02:02.25] ACTION: Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.

[00:48.90-00:50.80] CATHERINE (Gloating): "Do you remember?"
[00:49.00-00:52.00] ACTION: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
[00:51.00-00:54.80] CATHERINE (Viciously Delighted): "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."
[00:54.80-00:59.00] CAMERA: Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
[00:55.20-00:57.50] SOUND: Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.
[00:55.50-00:58.80] CATHERINE (Quietly Venomous): "And everyone watched you walk away alone."
[00:59.00-01:05.50] CAMERA: Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.
[00:59.20-01:01.30] JULIANA (Proud, Measured): "Gerald chose money."
[01:01.50-01:03.50] JULIANA (Resolute): "Clarissa chose a coward."
[01:03.80-01:05.30] JULIANA (Unyielding): "I chose myself."
[01:05.50-01:07.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.
[01:05.60-01:07.40] CATHERINE (Disgusted): "You chose a beggar."
[01:07.50-01:10.50] CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.
[01:07.60-01:09.80] JULIANA (Fierce, Proud): "I chose a man."
[01:10.50-01:13.30] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.
[01:10.80-01:13.20] CATHERINE (Contemptuous): "A scarred nobody."
[01:13.30-01:17.60] CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.
[01:13.50-01:17.60] JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified): "A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."
[01:17.60-01:20.45] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.
[01:17.80-01:20.20] CATHERINE (Incredulous, Mocking): "You call that marriage?"
